**Finding 1 (high/correctness)** — addressed by editing `cli.py:2383-2410` (`_validate_external_refs_at_lock`) to lazily load the F001 capability manifest index via a new test-injectable `_CAPABILITY_INDEX_FACTORY` seam + `_capability_index_for_external_refs()` helper, and pass it through as `capability_index=` to `ers.validate_refs_for_lock(...)`. The manifest load is gated on `any(ref.capability_id is not None for ref in refs)` so legacy plans (and operators without a capabilities directory) don't pay the load cost or block on a missing manifests dir — preserves backward compat while making unknown/incompatible IDs fail loud at the real CLI lock seam.
